releaseNotes: - New: every measurement print includes a customer slip: ID NO (large), each garment with its quantity circled, and the balance still owed (left off when fully paid).
- Where it prints: 1 garment -> 2nd block; 2 garments -> 3rd block; 3 garments -> a second sheet. Measurement blocks are unchanged.
- Fixed: measurement slips printed lighter than bills. They now print through the same Canon XPS printer as bills.
- Everything else is the same as v26.8.8.
